description: Authoritative inventory of source artifacts used by the CBS RMT normalization pipeline.

artifacts.notes: Legacy episode catalog containing episode number, date, title, plot, writer text, original-writer text, and genre identifier.
Legacy cast/person catalog. Biographical dates require validation because some records contain implausible values.
Legacy writer subset using the same person-shaped structure as the cast catalog.
Legacy genre lookup. Source spelling is preserved; canonical spelling corrections are transformations, not source edits.
Historical program log used as corroborating source material.
Historical spreadsheet source. Binary input is fingerprinted but never rewritten by normalization tooling.
Legacy MySQL database export used for reconciliation and provenance, not as the canonical physical schema.
Legacy MySQL Workbench model retained as architecture evidence.
